Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest.

Obtained
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.
Obtained
Checkpoint unlocked.
Stay here.

That's―――
I-it was YOUR fault for spacing out!
You even had your #C000246204SG#CDEF taken…

While #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF pumps her fists excitedly,
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF shakes his head in disbelief.
His eyes turn to the table draped in a white cloth.

…so, the amazing strategy you came up with
is this food?

But, I guess……
Hmm………

Oh? Interested in my sample, are we?
Well, I didn't make it for you.

EAT. UP.
I'll make roasted mince meat out of you
otherwise!
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF takes a fork in hand and faces the meal.
*gulp*――!
BLARGHHHHHHHH!!!
Waaaahhh!!!?
Whaaa!?
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF―is #C236196003Shinji#CDEF alright!!!?

This'll blow #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF's stomach sky-high
before Charm kicks in―――

No, they've come to us.
Hurry and fix yourself up.
It's basic manners.

Come now, first is the morning table.
Follow me.
Welcome to the first table: morning.
Ermm, is this… spaghetti?

In any case, the hell tour is taking off.
Focus, Master.
Remember #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF's advice.
Elizabeth, we know what you're scheming!
Eating that won't end well, will it!?
Huh…? Wha―no way!
………*sigh*.
I'm breaking off your lifeline.
Sorry, I'M SORRY! Anything but that!

STOPPP! You think my Darling is going to be
fed on some other woman's cooking!?
I. SHALL. EAT.
Gah, that's…
This time, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF snaps her finger at me.
I guess… I have to eat…

This should be fine. It looks alright.
Doesn't smell off. Maybe #C236196003Shinji#CDEF just has bad taste.
It's fine… it's fine…
It just tasted like chaos.
I'll be blunt.
Wh… what did you say…!?
Ah―Hey! Wait up!

Ta-da!
Enjoy this special stew I painstakingly,
slowly simmered.

I call it:
"Bon Voyage to the Blood Red Sea"!
There's a crimson stew served in this deep bowl.

As usual, it looks fine…
but that no longer offers me any solace.

Hmmmm, how soooo?
That's just how it came. Yep.
Suddenly, our eyes meet.

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF grips the hem of her skirt,
looking like she's about to cry.

No! No, no! I don't want it to get thrown away!
Do that, and I PROMISE I won't open that door!
She said that she "painstakingly, slowly simmered" this stew.
…#[piggy][squirrely]#?
Awful.
I-is it…!?
…………hang in there, Shinji-boy.
I know. But it paid off.
The final round is about to start――

The night table.
As I imagined, the table is
crammed with an exorbitant amount of food.

…sure, we can easily open that door if we use
the unarmed Shinji-boy.

But as a Servant, I can't idly watch by as my
Master's stomach gets destroyed.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF…
Thanks. Your sympathy helps steady my nerves.

This food was prepared by #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF for #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF.

This food was prepared by #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF for #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF.

F-f-f-for REALLLL!!??
There it is! The marriage proposal!
I'm holding you to it!
―――A-alright. Here I go.

I glance at #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF, who's staring at me
intently and paying no heed to #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's uproar.
Yes… Help yourself.

Hey! That single bite did a ton of
damage to you!
Are you really going to be alright?

Why is it so… so red…?
Put a little green in it or something!
That's what I would do!

YOU'RE too calm, #C236196003Rani#CDEF!
Please stop #[him][her]#!
I can't bear to watch this…!
That was a really fun idea.
"Want to try it then?"

#[Yep][Mhm]#, I want some.
But my belly is filled with enough chaos
as it is, so―――
"No worries. My curry is excellent."

#C080080080Within my wandering mind,#CDEF
#C236196003Julius#CDEF#C080080080 and #CDEF#C236196003Leo#CDEF#C080080080 present curry to me while smiling.#CDEF
Master! Get a grip on yourself!
Darling! Please come back to us!

Woah! You ate it all!
And the doors are fully open!
………how did you find the taste?
This is what I have to say―――
It was very delicious.

I hastily add:
"The food you made for me satisfied my heart
along with my stomach."

That said―――I know perfectly well how much
she toiled to prepare all this food for me.
"It tasted bad. Thank you," I tell her.

So he ran?
No matter. The end is nigh anyway.
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF absentmindedly watches her own body deteriorate.

Livestock, other nobles, they'd all praise me.
Well, I did hang anyone who didn't, but――

Really stunning work today, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
I kind of feel full myself…

You cannot carry any more
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.
I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

Return to the old school?

Have yourself a small shock to kick things off.
If we went straight to the main course, you'd be
liable to get overwhelmed and keel over.

There's a table draped in a blindingly pure white cloth.
As if it were stained with a single drop of blood―――
some sort of red food is placed on top of it.

Precisely: ostrich bolognese!
I even handled skewering the ostrich dead
myself!

………this hits hard. And in various ways.
Truth be told, I glossed it over at first and
figured it was soup or something.
THIS is the kind of stuff nobles chow down on…!?

Hmph. It doesn't look so bad. While it may
be heavy on the red, I would say it looks
well-plated.

I'm interested in my rival's cooking…
But still, don't fail to heed #C236196003Rin#CDEF's advice,
Master.

Surprisingly upfront about it, isn't she? Yeah,
well, there's an issue with the color. Being
flat red doesn't do our appetites any justice.

Grr… She's astoundingly, plainly vain about it,
isn't she? The only word she knows is
"sanguine," and it shows!

But there's bad news for her! We see through
this entire ploy. Now, Darling! Please give her
a piece of your mind!

It's far too heavy on the spices, but it may
just pass as a delicacy.
So, what will you do?

Will you submit and be done in by this dish?
Or will you preserve your humanity and
reject it? Choose whichever you fancy.

That's right. Regardless of what's on the menu,
there's no need to eat it.

WHY!? There was nothing in my perfectly crafted
invitation or humble demeanor that should've
given me away!

Every detail was a dead giveaway.
We outed her from the moment we read that invitation.

Anyway, even #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF isn't so
much of a pushover as to fall for this―――!!

Every detail was a dead giveaway.
And as for that surveillance footage…
I can't be bothered to mention it, nevermind.

Anyway, even #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF isn't so
much of a pushover as to fall for this―――!!

Gah… If the cat's out of the bag then so be it.
Still, you have no right to refuse.
THIS is why!
There, behind #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF.

A sturdy door, one that I've seen at some
point on another floor, blocks the path.

Why would I ever forget about this pesky door?
No, how could I ever forget?

That door―――It's the mortifying artificial
Noble Phantasm that "commando" #C236196003Rani#CDEF crafted:
The#C000246204 Fully Automatic, Strip-Style OpenLock (Patent pending)#CDEF!!

It's been modded, so there's no more stripping
involved… It's an automatic eat-it-all-style
OpenLock. *bleh*

Yep. Which means you can't proceed
until you finish the whole plate.

So eat up. Eat quick. Clean that plate
of my assorted cooking until it's clean…
It's the only choice you have, #ROFS0002#RUBSdarling#RUBEpiggy#REND!

So eat up. Eat quick. Clean that plate
of my assorted cooking until it's clean…
It's the only choice you have, #RUBS    honey#RUBEsquirrely#REND!

Hold, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF. Would it still count if I partook?
I would think it makes no difference,
so long as the plate is cleaned.

Being a food taster is a Servant's job.
I'll eat instead of my Master.
It's all the same in the end, no?

Wait. If eating it all suffices, then it should
matter not if I'm the one who eats, yes? I have
a useful food tasting Noble Phantasm.
Sorry to say, but I saw that one coming…

That food data can't be #RUBS  deleted#RUBEdigested#REND unless it's
#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF who does it―it's user-restricted.
It won't work on some other schmuck.

My word…! You knave!
You were doing more than merely
standing there looking all pale…!

…got it. I took you for a clever guy when it
came to things that don't matter, but I'll give
you props this time. And in your state, too.

Ughhh. Bravo―to seaweed!?
I'm ashamed to say that I'll be unable
to help you, #RUBS  Master#RUBEDarling#REND… *sob, sob, sob*

Impudent little seaweed…
You seem to have a knack for the little details.

Not bad. You ARE my attendant, shit as you are.
No stalling, #[piggy][squirrely]#. Ready yourself and get
to eating. It'll feel like flying to heaven.

I try to think about how I can escape
her fingertip's command, escape from everyone's gaze―
but nothing comes to me.

I sit at the table, nervous.
Before me is a red mass―――Ostrich bolognese.

This should be fine. It looks alright.
Doesn't smell off.
#[H-he][Sh-she]# went into a tailspin!?

I-I didn't expect it to be THIS bad…
Pull yourself together, #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND!
Don't leave me in this world all alone…!

You're pushing it, hey!
Spit it out, spit it out now! Hold on, I'll go
get water―――shit! We're in the Labyrinth!!

Hey, are you alright!?
This screen isn't doing any favors for her
image as a lady…!
Stop, stop the cameras! No filming allowed!

Kyaaaaa! Darlinggggg!? Shooting rockets
out of your mouth and spinning thrice
backwards―you're hardly human anymore!!!

D-damn you, #C236196003lizard woman#CDEF!
As bad as I am at cooking, something THIS awful
wouldn't happen from MY food!

A massive amount of ether was expelled the
moment #[he][she]# ate it…!?

Even the propellants for my #RUBS       vimana   #RUBEgolden sailboat#REND
don't compare! Is this humanity's oldest―no,
newest invention: death-by-blast cooking!?

W-we have to act!
#[His][Her]# vitals are dropping at an impossible rate!
#[He][She]#'s going down at mach speed!

There is… no poison. Which means a
double-attack occurs on one's palate AND mind
due to the purely "horrible flavor."

You have to be joking! All this damage, ONLY
from the awful taste!?
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF… You're one scary girl…!!

The flavor was epic.
It wasn't anything simple,
like being entirely sweet or entirely spicy.

My stomach won't stop churning, sweat won't stop dripping―
My entire body is rejecting this foreign substance.

But I mustn't give in. I mustn't vomit.
If I yield to the surging urge,
our path will forever be closed…!

―――Teary eyed, I somehow manage to cram it
all down into my stomach.

S-so how was it? What did you think?
Those are tears of joy, right? Right?

―――It's terrible.
It's not a question of whether it tastes good or bad.
This has reached the realm of mass destruction.
Terrorism, basically.

For example―――well, I can't think of an example,
but if I HAD to come up with one―――
it's like licking a candy, and tasting turpentine… times 1,000.
No, that still might be understating it.

See how my #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND splendidly finished it all!?
Open that door. Then you can taste the
same agony―upon your flesh!

Good job, Master. Alright, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF.
Open the door. Personally, I want to get
started on our payback.

We'll indulge in this farce no longer! Will you
hurry and open that door behind you? Or at
least go take some cooking classes, please!

…you finished it all, to the point that your
eyes are bulging like a dead fish.
That was admirable…

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. I'll say it just this once:
you exhibited a caliber suitable to being
my Master. Rest in peace.

―――That's done with.
Now, open the door, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF.
This banquet has only just begun, hasn't it?

…I messed up. #[He][She]# doesn't seem to like
bolognese… I didn't do enough research…
Soup would've been foolproof and I knew it…

T-this was only the beginning. Next up is
the main dish, the MAIN dish! You're NOT going
to be disappointed this time!
…you're something else, #[man][girl]#.
The two of them run off further into the Labyrinth.

Are you okay, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF?
It looks like your #RUBS   HP  #RUBEvitality#REND dropped, is all…
Think you can keep going?

…I'm probably… alright.
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's stomach hasn't burst yet.

Also, thanks to that thunderous shock,
it seems that #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF didn't Charm me.
That's the silver lining.

So, next is the lunch table…
The least I can do is let you lean on me
as we make our way there.

So, two left now… I dropped the ball here…
I should've ordered stomach medicine
at the Commissary…

How regrettable…
However, this may be a chance to use for
#C236196003Tamamo#CDEF's benefit.

Now that you've had such a savage experience,
you'll think anything I cook up tastes good―
even if it comes out a bit sloppy…

Don't lose heart. You're the type of mongrel
who can do what you put your mind to. If you
endured it once, you can endure it again.

Man…
I still have yet to digest the bolognese,
but here we are at the next table.

Welcome to table two: the lunch table.
This dish is sure to astonish you!

#C236196003#NICK#CDEF, wait!
We're going to send you some software
we found for this exact job.

We downloaded an unarmed Shinji familiar
that eats food. It's free software,
so we paid nothing for it.

Hold on a 'sec!
Why's it set to have MY face on it!?
You DEFINITELY customized that thing!

This software specializes in processing food.
That's all it can do… so don't hold back.
Pour all that edible destruction into it.

It's set to #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's user
and shares the same privileges, so it should
be able to clear the restriction issue.

#C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF do it again, such a great job.
Now I should have nothing to fear with that food anymo―――

I-I won't allow this. You expect me to serve
my food to some… some filthy doll…
That would be unbelievably humiliating.

Impossible, actually. You're a farm animal,
so eat up like you crave it. Drain that bowl
until there isn't even a drop left…!

Another tantrum? Bad habit you got there.
Still, no matter how much noise you make, that
door will open once the plate is cleaned.

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF says no more, not even "stop it"
or "just try it" or the like.
I think it's because she can't.

But in the end, no matter what she does…
the dish she labored to prepare is going
to get thrown into the #ROFS-005#RUBSShinji-boy#RUBEtrash#REND right before her eyes.
I'm sure it's unbearable for her.

…if I want to unravel #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's mind,
I get the feeling that I shouldn't rely on the
Shinji-boy―――

Mhm. It won't do otherwise. I'm not supporting
her per se, but I don't want to see my Praetor
be inconsiderate of a maiden's feelings.

*sigh* …let me ask, just in case.
What are you planning to do with that spoon
you're clutching, Master?

*sigh*, my Darling is always like this…
What are you planning to do with that spoon?

One's esophagus is crucial.
Fine, go ahead and die along with
that demon-dish.

Just one sip. So long as it's one sip.
This courage will surely lead to her #C000246204SG#CDEF.
―――I think as such, then try taking a sip of the stew.
It's horrid. Terrible. Overpowering. Pungent.

It's like mud. It makes me wonder if maybe #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF
isn't a Heroic Spirit from Earth,
but rather from Venus with some polar opposite culture.

…but the saving grace here was that the ingredients
were all tender, at least.
Seems like she really did painstakingly prepare it.
I command my body to, at last, finish a mere sip.
…what do you think… of this one?

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF questions me with a grave expression.
This dish is…
Terrible.
It's alright, I guess…

I-it can't be…! I let it simmer for so long!
I did my very best, there's no way it
came out bad!

You merely tried to brute-force it. Laboring
to learn the culinary arts and refine
one's technique produces results.

Toil alone won't make it good.
To make the finest dish, proper knowledge
and a process are necessary.

Regardless of what the cook thinks, if the one
eating thinks it tastes bad, then that's that.
It wouldn't be so onerous if love was enough.

You misunderstand ingredients vs skill. Premium
ingredients are premium because top chefs use
them. Third-rate ingredients suit third-rates.

That's right.
Now that I got my thoughts on the dish across,
I'll have the unarmed Shinji-boy process what's left.

How silly of me, of all people, to get genuinely
worried for even a second. Yeah, that's right.
Of course. You understand how good it is!

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF, perhaps out of relief, happily wags her dragon tail.
It seems like she really
did take making this stew pretty seriously.

…that said, I expect that there's still a nighttime
table waiting for me. Sorry, but I'll be leaving
the rest of this to the unarmed Shinji-boy.

Fine, there's still the main course left.
I'll let you off the hook this time.

The next one should move you to cry, saying
how delicious it is, I'm sure of it.
…be prepared.

Huh, that's it!?
Agh, damn it! She just does whatever she wants!

Thanks to the unarmed Shinji-boy's outstanding work,
the crimson stew was processed instantly.

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF may have been acting tough in
her own way by leaving before watching this happen.

And―unlock complete.
Who's a hard little worker, Shinji-boy鷙
Maybe we shouldn't have made it look like him.

Umm, Senpai? Are you okay…?
You had the processing software, so you didn't
have to push yourself to eat, yet…

She has an obsession with cooking.
It's likely related to the next #C000246204SG#CDEF―――

Yes. The structure of a floor is considerably
influenced by the Core's secrets. Please
investigate in that direction without pause.
Yeah, without pause.

I take the stomach medicine I got from
#C236196003Sakura#CDEF out of my pocket and down it all in one go.

After looping around the Labyrinth,
we finally reach the last table.

A full red course.
A red Manchu-Han imperial feast.
No matter where I look, all I see is red.
